CustomObject.description: The epic the public board features (build 10). Hierarchy, and only the org default is used, so there is one featured epic by construction. Epic_Id__c holds the Work_Item__c Id as text, because a custom setting cannot hold a lookup. Written only by FeaturedEpicService - from the internal board's button, behind Portfolio_HQ_Feature_Epic, or from scripts/apex/set-featured-epic.apex. Read by both board controllers with no query. Data, not metadata: it does not deploy, and a new org features nothing until the owner sets it. An Id that no longer resolves to a public epic under a public project reads as none.
CustomObject.label: Featured Epic
